question: What benefit follows from worship performed in the month of Aśvayuj?
premises: Worship is performed in Aśvayuj month
The worshipper becomes free from sorrow
The worshipper prevails over enemies on earth
inference: Worship in Aśvayuj yields sorrowlessness and victory over enemies.
plain_english: Having worshipped in the month of Aśvayuj, one becomes free from sorrow and overcomes enemies on earth.
